author: cellish
body:
Hi! I've been having this map for quite a long time now, so I just wanted to post it on the forums and hope to get accepted :)

Players: 12v12
Monuments: Left A, Left B - Right A, Right B
Images: http://imgur.com/a/clmHc
Teams: Orange v Lime

You get 4 XP Bottles from each kill, + 1 gapple, (there are ench tables)

There are 6 diamond blocks on each side of the map and then 6 diamond blocks in the mid.

Hope you like it!! <3

Download: Not yet

XML/YML or whatever (Need help)

replies.author: imryaan
replies.body:
Good job so far! (Love those floor patterns) 

You should add some elevation to the map because it looks quite flat (from what I can see) and the middle islands(3) could have a structure such as an arch etc.  Also, you should make the monument islands bigger (so that they're easier to defend) and make the gap between the spawn and monument island bigger because it seems a little too close. 

http://imgur.com/tGTVEhC 

By the way, I recommend you take more screenshots because I can't see much of the map.

Good luck with the map! :) -Ryan
